capabilities: Search the active note ignoring diacritical marks with a Chrome-style search bar
Find and replace matches within the current note, one at a time or all at once
Search all markdown files in the vault with highlighted context and match counts
Replace a term across all vault files in one click
Navigate matches with keyboard shortcuts, buttons, and clickable scrollbar markers
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Matching works both ways via Unicode NFD normalization, so queries with or without diacritics both match.
problem: Obsidian's search misses matches when typed text and note text differ in diacritics, so searching without vowel marks or accents fails to find vocalized Hebrew, Arabic, or accented Latin words.
summary: Diacritics-insensitive search and replace in the active note and across the vault, matching Hebrew nikud, Arabic tashkil, accents, and other Unicode marks.
